gloss: at its best for drinking; ready to drink

definitions.gloss: at its best for drinking; ready to drink; at the ideal drinking temperature or maturity
definitions.explanation: The optimal state for consuming a beverage, whether in terms of temperature, age (for wine), or brewing time (for tea). Often used for wine, sake, tea, and other drinks where timing or temperature matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}だ。
examples.english: This wine is at its best for drinking right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{冷|さ}めて→冷める：02114_sameru⟧{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}になった。
examples.english: The coffee cooled down a bit and is now at a good drinking temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やして→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that this sake is at its ideal drinking temperature when served chilled.

notes:
Composed of the verb stem ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) and the suffix ⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧ (suitable time, peak). Indicates the ideal moment to enjoy a beverage based on temperature, maturity, or freshness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: ideal drinking temperature
- {飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to reach the right point for drinking
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}: now is the best time to drink it

USAGE:
- Wine: refers to the aging period where flavor peaks
- Tea: refers to the right steeping time and temperature
- Coffee: refers to having cooled enough from scalding hot
- Beer: refers to freshness or optimal serving temperature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}→食べ頃：26567_tabegoro⟧: ready to eat — the same pattern for food
- ⟦{見|み}{頃|ごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧: at its best for viewing — for flowers, scenery
